messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take prednisone if you have a systemic fungal infection, which is a fungal infection that has spread through your body.
Prednisone weakens your immune system.
This makes it easier to get an infection.
An existing infection may become worse.
An existing infection can reactivate an old infection, such as tuberculosis or hepatitis B.
It can also hide the usual signs of infection.
An infection may be advanced before you notice it.
Tell your doctor about any illness or infection you have had in the past few weeks.
Stay away from people who are sick.
Chickenpox and measles can be serious or even fatal in someone taking a steroid.
Call your doctor straight away if you are exposed to either one.
Do not have a live vaccine while you are taking prednisone unless your doctor says it is safe.
Do not stop taking prednisone suddenly after more than a few days of treatment.
Your body needs time to start making its own steroid hormones again.
Your doctor will lower your dose in steps.
Call your doctor at once if you have shortness of breath.
Triplet: ["prednisone", "can mask", "signs of infection"]

The relation 'can mask' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may conceal or hide the typical symptoms or signs of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may worsen': The subject drug may cause the medical condition specified by the object entity to become more severe.
B. None of the above.
